algorithm.name: AES-256-GCM
algorithm.aad_rule: components must be non-empty and must not contain ':'

canonical_plaintext_rules: Credential payloads are serialized as canonical JSON before sealing:
object keys sorted lexicographically, no whitespace (separators ',' and ':'),
null-valued optional fields omitted entirely, non-ASCII left unescaped,
In TypeScript: JSON.stringify over an object built with sorted key insertion
order and absent optionals, then TextEncoder().encode(...).
fingerprint_rule: first 8 hex characters of sha256(secret material); secret material is access_token for kind=oauth and secret for kind=api_key

vectors.name: api_key_alpaca_paper
vectors.description: API key-pair payload, workspace A / alpaca / paper, master key v1.

vectors.name: oauth_access_only_ibkr_paper
vectors.description: OAuth payload without refresh token — refresh_token is omitted from the canonical JSON, not serialized as null. Workspace B / ibkr / paper, key v1.

vectors.name: oauth_with_refresh_alpaca_paper
vectors.description: OAuth payload carrying both tokens; note the sorted key order (access_token, kind, refresh_token). Workspace A / alpaca / paper, key v1.

vectors.name: api_key_second_master_key
vectors.description: Same payload shape under master key v2 — proves key_id selects the key and that a v1 opener must refuse this row.

vectors.name: raw_bytes_non_ascii
vectors.description: Not a credential payload: pins the UTF-8 encoding contract for the credential-agnostic seal_bytes/open_bytes layer (non-ASCII is encoded as UTF-8, never escaped).

vectors.name: raw_bytes_single_byte
vectors.description: Shortest legal plaintext (1 byte): ciphertext is exactly 1 + 16 bytes, so a 17-byte ciphertext must be accepted while 16 or fewer must be rejected as truncated.

negative_cases.detail: open with master key v2 instead of v1
drop the final byte of ciphertext_hex
XOR 0x01 into the final ciphertext byte (inside the GCM tag)
XOR 0x01 into the first ciphertext byte (inside the body)
